source_paper: SplitGNN: Spectral Graph Neural Network for Fraud Detection against Heterophily (CIKM 2023)
raw_file: comp.dgl (shipped directly inside the official SplitGNN repository, data/FDCompCN.zip)
readme_cross_check: README states 559 fraud (10.51%), 4758 benign, 57 features — matches exactly.
edge_count_discrepancy_note: Empirical edge counts loaded directly from the official comp.dgl file do not match the SplitGNN README's summary table. Every relation shows extensive self-loops, strongly suggesting the README table reports pre-self-loop-augmentation counts while the shipped .dgl file includes them. Labels (559/4758) and feature dimension (57) match the README exactly. Edge topology is used AS SHIPPED without modification.
native_masks_note: SplitGNN ships its own native train/valid/test masks. NOT used for the unified (Track B) benchmark split — a team-frozen 40/20/40 split is generated independently, same as every other dataset.
